shared_components.funding: same hourly settled funding + adverse reserve; notional changes dollars
shared_components.cooldown: same current rule/duration; last admitted instant is account-local; never filters source stream
shared_components.degradation: same current rule: 100 finalized hypothesis trades, recent 50, mean trade_return <= -0.005 and >=40 losses; permanent per account; never changes upstream hypothesis availability
shared_components.control: current admit/monitor/mark/close behavior from pinned main; baseline replay sizer is not a replacement for runtime control
shared_components.priority: economic_ratio_desc_score_desc_asset_hypothesis_signal; identical frozen source priority inputs; no cohort-dependent reorder
shared_components.lifecycle: same state machine and exit predicates; candidate drawdown admission halt leaves monitoring/exits/funding/accounting obligations active
shared_components.exit_geometry: unchanged; TP/SL study excluded; +0.8-0.9R TP vs -1.08R stops is motivation for a later study only

signal_contract.principle: Cohort assignment must not change whether the underlying trade idea exists.
signal_contract.generation: one causal source stream before account-dependent admit; one immutable source record fan-out to both cohorts
signal_contract.source_eligibility: hypothesis registration/side/predicate, causal timing, warmup, health, context, universe readiness, shared quote/funding availability, thesis geometry and current base-cost economics; no account state
signal_contract.account_filters: support/conflict, episode deduplication, cooldown, degradation, capacity and halt applied locally using unchanged rules
signal_contract.pins: cohort risk pins retain lifecycle data; they cannot confer source entry eligibility or alter ranking/promotion; shared acquisition must cover union of obligations without selection feedback
signal_contract.dispatch: every source row produces exactly two cohort decisions including unavailable/halted; no dropped rows, no backfills before start frontier
signal_contract.schedule: same source evaluation batch and quote frontier; prior fills/exits/funding/marks applied in current engine order, identical timestamp ordering across cohorts; source priority evaluated before account filters
signal_contract.timing: same first observed fresh future bid/ask after intent; no cohort choosing a better quote; later source ideas can have divergent admission; rejected opportunity is never retried using a later quote under same ID

pairing_contract.identity_formula: sourceopportunity_ + SHA256(canonical JSON of identity_fields); excludes cohort/run/account/evaluation outcome
pairing_contract.source_record_hash: SHA256(canonical JSON of complete source record); first causal finalized record is immutable; conflicting payload under same ID is a kill incident
pairing_contract.unavailable: explicit nulls and unavailable_reason_codes; do not fabricate missing thesis/quotes; ineligible rows retained and excluded from eligible-opportunity denominator
pairing_contract.decisions: append-only sizing/admission record plus append-only lifecycle events; no overwrites; trade_id nullable for nonentries; SUPPORTED is unchanged existing exposure, not a new trade
pairing_contract.account_snapshot: content-addressed equity, cash, peak, marked open exposures, pending reservations, gross/net/margin/open-risk/cluster risk, cooldown/episode/degradation states, halt status, mark quotes and frontier

source_shapes.entry_quote: bid, ask, observed/received/available timestamps, provider/session, quote ID; <=3s old at eligibility and actual fill
source_shapes.volatility_move_definition: entry_volatility_move_v1; fractional_price_move; formula/source/available_at; unchanged causal entry geometry
source_shapes.stop_invalidation: full frozen thesis invalidation including price, state rule, emergency price
source_shapes.priority_inputs: RV, round_trip_cost, score, asset, hypothesis, signal timestamp + universe evaluation ID
source_shapes.attribution: family, source_phase, asset, CORE/SATELLITE, side, existing causal regime/context/version or UNAVAILABLE

pairing_contract.timestamp_encoding: All timestamps: timezone-aware UTC ISO-8601 with exactly six fractional second digits and +00:00 suffix; normalize before creating source identity/record hash. Reject aliases, naive or noncanonical source records rather than giving one instant multiple IDs.

protocol_deviations.rule: every divergence outside frozen sizing/account-path effects is an incident; preserve both records and affected source frontier; material deviations kill admissions and invalidate confirmatory conclusions

prerequisites: OVH zero-authority soak PASS or explicitly approved PASS WITH LIMITATION
required warmup/readiness gates satisfied naturally without backdating
current merged full suite passes on activation revision
real entry evidence records positive causal volatility_move with correct definition/version and immutable lifecycle propagation

read-only offline sizing replay reconciles every finalized historical trade: control units/notional/net PnL within existing reconcile tolerances, no unexplained discrepancy; unavailable legacy inputs disclosed
future adapter/dispatcher rehearsal proves complete pairing, fail-closed inputs, exact frozen control, throttle/halt and lifecycle behavior without authority
activation metadata sealed before first source opportunity, paper-only authority boundary verified
explicit user approval to register/activate both named cohorts and acceptance of disclosed cost-model limitation

commissioning.throughput: no unaccounted source rows or unresolved worker backlog; lifecycle ticks and quote freshness comply with frozen execution deadlines
commissioning.purpose: 72h covers funding/day boundaries; counts require actual lifecycle exercise when flow is low; counts are cumulative from baseline activation, with additional clean window after a material fix
commissioning.exclusion: commissioning trades never enter paired evidence; both cohorts later start fresh at $100 at identical new frontier; no first-trade activation

count_definitions.settled_paired_opportunities: eligible source IDs with both terminal decisions and all associated trades accounting_final; both skipped count here only
count_definitions.both_taken_finalized: source IDs with one finalized new trade in each cohort; SUPPORTED/pending not trades
count_definitions.finalized_per_cohort: accounting_final CLOSED trades, excluding commissioning and legacy history
count_definitions.hypothesis_diversity: distinct hypothesis IDs among both-taken finalized pairs, >=5 pairs each
count_definitions.family_diversity: distinct preexisting family labels among both-taken finalized pairs, >=10 pairs each
count_definitions.regime_diversity: preexisting causally timestamped regime/context classes with pinned definition; >=20 both-taken pairs each; unavailable does not count; no retrospective labels
count_definitions.market_days: UTC wall time since common activation, plus observed source-health coverage >=95%; any operational kill censors experiment rather than resetting clock

evidence.state_rule: highest state whose ALL minima pass, at scheduled checkpoints only; no unresolved material incident; absent causal regime taxonomy blocks DECISION_ELIGIBLE
evidence.horizon: Formal primary decision at first scheduled checkpoint on/after day 90 satisfying DECISION_ELIGIBLE; fixed administrative end day 180 regardless of outcomes; if unmet by then INCONCLUSIVE. Once chosen, primary frontier is immutable; later checkpoints are secondary. Never extend or terminate based on PnL.
evidence.terminal: day 180 stops new admissions; existing lifecycle drains naturally; scientific snapshot stays at fixed frontier; no forced expiry/exit to meet counts
evidence.halt_exception: a frozen account halt/safe depletion can prevent count minima forever; report descriptive survival failure, never relax thresholds or reset account
evidence.inference: thresholds are governance minima, not a power calculation; one correlated adaptive account path cannot establish general superiority. Insufficient diversity or uncertainty means INCONCLUSIVE, even with enough trades

primary_endpoint.comparison_frontier: same fixed UTC checkpoint for both accounts, including marked open positions, fees, simulated execution costs, settled funding and adverse reserves; halted cash remains in path

equations.floor_budget: sizing distance budget is separate from intended risk at actual thesis stop

primary_endpoint.mark_grid: same observed two-second lifecycle marks; use joint timestamp union with causally carried last known quotes only while fresh; stale segments flagged, never interpolated to suppress drawdown
ordered_rule: integrity first: material protocol/accounting defects or unresolved missing marks => INVALID_FOR_DECISION

safety/continuity: candidate liquidation, liquidation-safety breach, or candidate halt while control survives => NO_CANDIDATE_PREFERENCE; both halt => NO_SUPERIORITY; control-only halt is reported, not automatic proof
evidence minima and scheduled horizon must pass; otherwise descriptive/inconclusive

candidate supports preference only if net return >= control, max drawdown <= control, and at least one exceeds practical threshold: >=1 percentage point more return OR >=0.5 percentage point less drawdown; candidate net return must be positive

control dominance uses symmetric return/drawdown inequalities and practical thresholds; both losing => NO_POSITIVE_EDGE; mixed return/drawdown => INCONCLUSIVE; within thresholds => NO_MATERIAL_DIFFERENCE

intended/realized risk, excess losses, capacity skips, halts and exposure accompany verdict; any unexplained impossible risk or safety breach vetoes preference; never trade extra drawdown for return using a retuned ratio

uncertainty.method: Paired joint 7-UTC-day moving-block resampling of aligned intraday account mark-return increments, retaining the full observed mark grid inside each block; 10000 draws; seed 20261014. Sample overlapping whole-day-start blocks uniformly with replacement for both cohorts together, concatenate until the original market-time length, trim excess, reconstruct equity from $100 and recompute net return and intraday maximum drawdown. Report 95% percentile intervals, number of available blocks and serial dependence. This does not rerun adaptive admission or sizing; daily-close drawdown is not a substitute for the primary marked drawdown.
uncertainty.support: preference stays descriptive unless return-difference interval lower bound >=0 and drawdown-difference upper bound <=0; wide intervals => INCONCLUSIVE; joint block resampling is conditional sensitivity, not a calibrated claim of policy superiority

primary_endpoint.rationale: dominance avoids unstable return/drawdown ratios near zero and does not reward a higher balance bought with higher drawdown; survival and risk fidelity remain visible

paired_analysis.denominator: all eligible source opportunities after common start and <=checkpoint; unavailable inputs, cancelled entries, SUPPORTED and halted decisions retained by explicit substatus; never inner-join away divergent admissions
paired_analysis.outcomes: pending trades separately right-censored; settled means accounting_final; funding true-ups append provenance, never silently revise checkpoint
paired_analysis.capacity: record reservations/free capital/risk immediately before and after each source decision plus links to later capacity rejection IDs; no invented counterfactual outcome for untaken trade

metrics_definition.geometric_return: daily net equity ratio product and mean log daily return only for strictly positive equity and complete marks; no annualization
metrics_definition.expectancy_R: arithmetic mean final net PnL / frozen intended stop loss; invalid/nonpositive denominator UNAVAILABLE, never zero
metrics_definition.realized_loss_beyond_intended_risk: count, dollars, quantiles and worst ratio of -net PnL / intended loss >1
metrics_definition.drawdown_duration: longest UTC time underwater from peak through recovery or censored checkpoint
metrics_definition.exposures: time-weighted mean and max gross notional/equity, margin/equity, net exposure; no stale interpolation
metrics_definition.cost_drag: spread + slippage + entry/exit fees separately in dollars and % starting equity; funding separate; no double counting
metrics_definition.liquidation_near_miss: any observed adverse path reaches >=80% of frozen liquidation distance; one count per trade; report observation resolution and gaps
metrics_definition.liquidation: observed threshold breach or nonzero isolated liquidation adjustment; one count per trade; approximation, not venue liquidation confirmation

attribution.current_manifest: 28 Phase 22/23/24 hypotheses only; event is an empty labeled stratum, not permission to add Phase 30
attribution.subgroup: descriptive only unless >=100 both-taken finalized pairs, >=30 days, >=2 causal regimes; no promotion/selection from exploratory multiple comparisons; new confirmatory spec required

drawdown.candidate_peak: marked equity peak, monotonically nondecreasing; no reset
drawdown.recovery: current approved ladder is state-based: multiplier can recover when drawdown improves; this restores but never exceeds base risk; halt is absorbing
drawdown.boundary: inclusive >= thresholds; halt latched; cancel unfilled new-entry intents at halt; existing filled positions continue frozen stop/target/expiry/hold/funding obligations; no same-ID restart
drawdown.control: unchanged STOPPED catastrophe guard when marked equity <=25% peak; current stop_reason/exit_condition behavior preserved; no candidate ladder added
drawdown.candidate_algorithm: approved engine.size order including two impact passes, cost throttle evaluated at initial base geometry, final intended risk at actual invalidation, capacity risk based on unthrottled base budget; exact source hashes govern, no numerical cleanups

missing_data.reason_order: declared required input order; deduplicate codes; retain every missing field; no zero funding/no volatility/imagined depth substitution
missing_data.freshness: quote <=3s; every availability frontier <=decision; volatility definition source/time coherent with source thesis; depth from same contemporaneous quote snapshot; pinned fee, margin, size and funding definitions; stale/noncausal/mismatch => explicit UNAVAILABLE/REJECTED
missing_data.control: continue only as current frozen policy permits; prospective candidate precheck does not change current engine or control; record divergence
missing_data.implementation: offline contract checker is not runtime enforcement; approved historical sizer allows missing volatility, prospective adapter must reject it before sizing

slippage_limitation.statement: Current size-dependent slippage is a modeled assumption, not yet prospectively validated.
slippage_limitation.control: impact=none, existing constant core bps and satellite reference-depth classification
slippage_limitation.candidate: impact=sqrt_reference_notional; frozen bps * max(1,sqrt(notional/100)); two approved sizing iterations; exit uses same frozen impact assumption at recorded size
slippage_limitation.exception: exact approved policies have unequal impact settings; base fees/slippage sources/funding rules are shared, candidate impact is a declared sizing-policy package effect. This cannot identify a pure quantity-only causal effect above the reference; do not claim cost parity or silently change either policy
slippage_limitation.validation: retain contemporaneous quotes/depth/price bands/model predictions and simulated fills for every source and trade; simulated fill agreement is not real execution validation; no mid-cohort recalibration
slippage_limitation.approval: later explicit activation approval must acknowledge model asymmetry; demanding strict impact parity requires successor experiment specification before activation

operational_stop.action: fail closed on new admissions for both cohorts at first detected material condition; preserve source/decision/liquidity/account evidence; existing lifecycle safety obligations continue; no reset; append incident and last sound/first bad frontiers
operational_stop.stale: current <=3s quote age prevents admission; transient rejected quote recorded; continuous required feed failure >=180s or unresolved causal frontier corruption triggers operational kill
operational_stop.fix: any result-affecting fix requires incident + versioned successor cohorts/spec if semantics change + clear cutover frontier; original remains stopped/censored; no deletion of bad segment to improve performance
operational_stop.scientific: bad but safe performance alone does not kill or retune; follow scheduled checkpoint/account halt rules

immutability.semantic_change_requires: new specification ID/version/hash AND versioned successor cohort IDs; never reuse _v1
immutability.bug_fix: explicit incident record, result impact, successor cohort, cutover frontier; no silent semantic patch
immutability.proof: canonical JSON external SHA256 pinned in offline validator and regression tests; hash is tamper evidence, not access control; commit/review provenance required

activation_contract.freeze_method: append-only content-addressed activation manifest referencing this spec hash; ALL pending facts populated and sealed before registration or any opportunity; no edits to this specification to insert activation facts
activation_contract.same_frontier: identical activation timestamp and source/data frontier for both; signal must be strictly later, no queued commissioning ideas; fresh independent $100 cash/peak/equity each, zero positions/debt
activation_contract.runtime_limitation: current profile gates Dynamic Universe; later independently approved infrastructure successor must be pinned in activation manifest and cannot alter frozen signal/trade semantics
activation_contract.code_revision: pin exact later approved commit; source semantic parity against frozen manifests or new spec/cohort version; integration changes require reviewed tests before activation
activation_contract.funding_authority: public market data + simulated paper ledger only; no exchange/fund-movement keys; later real-money readiness separate

analysis_cadence.dashboards: operational health, raw account state and incidents; no winner ranking/leaderboard or superiority badges; primary comparisons only at scheduled checkpoints
analysis_cadence.interim: first four checkpoints descriptive/preliminary even if counts accumulate early; primary decision no earlier than day90; no policy changes between or at checkpoints under same IDs
analysis_cadence.registration: freeze this spec before observing new Dynamic Universe evidence; checkpoint reports append with exact input frontier/hash/code and preserve prior reports

future_compatibility.shared_intelligence: improved feeds must retain frozen causal semantics; schema/availability/hypothesis changes require successor experiment
future_compatibility.LLM: no LLM thesis contribution in this v1; future layer requires new spec/cohorts if inputs change; an LLM never sets size, leverage, risk fraction or drawdown thresholds

limitations: No prospective Dynamic Universe paired evidence; future integration and activation metadata not implemented or sealed by this task.
Exact approved control/candidate impact flags differ; inference is about declared sizing-policy packages with modeled impact, not pure cost-parity sizing.
Liquidation is approximate 1/L - 1/(2*venue_max_leverage); tiered maintenance/liquidity gaps not prospectively validated.
Single adaptive correlated market/account path, sparse strata and absent causal regime labels may prevent DECISION_ELIGIBLE or robust inference within 180 days.
The prospective contract adds fail-closed required volatility/depth evidence without changing existing sizing behavior; later adapter must prove enforcement.
